responsibility: This header declares GCC’s RAII-style C++ wrapper around libiberty’s `pex` process-execution interface. It defines `file_wrapper` for owned or borrowed `FILE *` handles with whole-file reading support, and `pex` for lifetime management of `pex_obj` together with convenience methods for launching subprocesses, opening input files or pipes, and reading child output streams. It is the host utility interface that wraps low-level `pex_*` calls in safer GCC-internal C++ ownership semantics.
same_name_distinction: Declares the `file_wrapper` and `pex` RAII wrapper types and their inline ownership/lifetime operations around libiberty `pex_*` calls. Unlike `pex.cc`, it defines the interface and object semantics rather than implementing the vector-argv conversion and whole-file reading logic.
